SANKALP SHARMA

Digital Transformation Consultant | Banking thesankalpsharma@gmail.com • +91 9090614430 • Mumbai, India •

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Business Analyst with 8 years of experience in digital transformation across banking and financial services, most recently embedded within a large public sector bank's multi-drop digitisation programme at IBM. Experienced in translating regulatory and risk requirements into control frameworks and operational processes, with exposure to access governance, audit sign-off, and compliance-driven design decisions across digital banking journeys. Brings end-to-end experience across payments, account services, demat, corporate onboarding, and government scheme integrations — from current state assessment and FSD authoring through to SIT coordination. Equally comfortable running client workshops, advising on process redesign, and staying hands-on with development and testing teams to see requirements through to production. Has a good working understanding of core banking systems and integration dependencies, and how these shape the scope and sequencing of digital change. Have also worked with international clients and stakeholders as part of some of these engagements, coordinating across time zones.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Consultant – Digital Banking Transformation | IBM India Pvt Ltd May 2022 – Present Digital Transformation Consultant

Primary BA on a multi-drop digital transformation programme — owned requirements, FSD authoring, and delivery coordination across modules covering dormant account activation, bulk payments, corporate onboarding, demat services, and government insurance schemes (PMSBY & PMJJBY), working directly with the client’s product and IT teams throughout.

Conducted current state assessments of banking processes and IT architecture — identified operational gaps, mapped as-is workflows against the desired end state, and advised on digital interventions to reduce manual touchpoints and improve straight-through processing across key journeys.

Authored FSDs and structured user stories for dormant account activation, bulk payments, corporate onboarding (Branch Portal), demat services, Smart Lock, and PMSBY/PMJJBY enrolment flows — giving development and QA teams a single, unambiguous reference point for each feature from first sprint to production sign-off.

Ran requirement workshops with business, IT, operations, and compliance teams — translated ambiguous business asks into scoped, deliverable requirements backed by clearly defined acceptance criteria, and resolved cross-functional conflicts before they reached development.

During requirement gathering sessions, always made it a point to check if the journey had any regulatory angle — if it did, took time to study the requirement properly and made sure the FSD reflected what was needed before development started

Delivered functional analysis and requirement support for international banking clients, covering both core banking modules and digital journeys

Defined API and integration specifications between Finacle (core banking), UPI switch, digital front- ends, and third-party providers — validated integration behaviour using Postman and SQL, catching critical API edge cases before SIT entry.

Led BA-side review of SIT test case suites — identified 17 missing scenarios in one cycle alone, coordinated resolution with the testing team, and brought test coverage up to standard before UAT entry, materially reducing post-go-live defect risk.

Collaborated with UX/UI designers and product owners to shape customer journeys across web and mobile channels — balancing usability goals against compliance requirements, Finacle constraints, and agreed turnaround time targets.

• Tracked live features post-launch, gathering feedback from business users and product owners,

prioritising backlog items for subsequent drops — keeping the programme roadmap grounded in real usage rather than original assumptions.

Also designed the audit log module for the onboarding journey, capturing every action and change for traceability — this helped the compliance and audit teams review activity

Team Leader – Business Analysis | IDBI Intech Core Banking Enhancements

Jan 2022 – Apr 2022

Led requirement gathering and change impact analysis for lending and account management enhancements on the core banking platform — worked directly with business SMEs to convert policy changes into clear functional specifications and development-ready business rules.

Coordinated SIT and UAT execution — triaged functional defects with the development team and ensured all critical issues were resolved before production sign-off, with no major post-release incidents during tenure.

Facilitated scope alignment workshops between business and IT — reduced ambiguity early in each enhancement cycle and cut the volume of mid-sprint change requests coming from misaligned expectations.

Tracked and escalated delivery risks proactively — maintained delivery transparency across business and vendor stakeholders, ensuring decision-makers had visibility of blockers before they became timeline issues.

Senior System Engineer – Functional Analysis | Infosys Ltd Banking Technology Delivery – Core Banking

Oct 2015 – Jun 2019

Delivered functional analysis and requirement support for banking clients across core banking, account servicing, and trade finance modules on Finacle-based implementations — working across onshore and offshore teams to maintain consistent scope and business rule clarity throughout.

Contributed to change request analysis and impact assessments across multiple enhancement cycles — helped project leads scope work accurately, reduced development rework from scope creep, and shortened overall delivery cycles.

Supported SIT and functional validation cycles on core banking builds — checked system behaviour systematically against business rules, raised defect reports, and worked with development to clear critical issues before UAT entry.

Worked with analytics teams to translate transactional data into management reporting dashboards — gave business stakeholders clear visibility into portfolio performance and processing trends across portfolio and account modules.

Delivered functional analysis and requirement support for international banking clients, covering both core banking modules.

KEY PROJECT HIGHLIGHTS

Dormant Account Activation

Led current state assessment and to-be journey design for dormant account activation across digital and branch channels — reduced manual touchpoints, cut average reactivation time from 5 days to same-day processing for eligible accounts, and authored the FSD covering CBS freeze logic and channel-specific flows. The freeze/unfreeze logic followed RBI's dormancy guidelines, this was a regulatory guideline.

Bulk Payments Platform

Authored FSDs and user stories for bulk payment processing (with and without beneficiary validation), covering STP rules, exception handling, file reconciliation, and reversal logic — greenfield build supporting high-volume corporate payment runs with full audit trail.

CIB Digital Onboarding

Owned FSD authoring for Corporate Internet Banking registration across the Assisted and Admin Portal — enabled self-service onboarding for business customers, eliminated branch dependency for standard corporate journeys, and covered the full lifecycle from registration through access management.

SmartLock – Digital Service Controls

Designed the functional specification for real-time lock/unlock of 5 digital services (Ease App, RIB, UPI, Debit Cards, Credit Cards) — resolved complex UPI switch API behaviour and the RIB self-locking paradox before development started, avoiding costly mid-sprint rework.

Demat Account Services

Authored FSD and defined end-to-end digital flows for demat account services — covering account linking, statement access, and channel integration between the bank’s digital platform and depository systems, with clear business rules for edge cases and error handling. This journey also had to follow SEBI and depository (NSDL/CDSL) guidelines around KYC linkage and account-level checks, so these were factored into the FSD as well

Regulatory & Compliance

Regulatory Requirement Analysis, Access Governance, Maker- Checker Controls, Audit Support, Compliance Coordination

PMSBY & PMJJBY Integration

Defined requirements and digital flows for Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) and Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) enrolment and renewal journeys — covering auto-debit logic, eligibility validation, premium processing, and branch portal integration for bank staff-assisted enrolment.

Access Rights & Entitlements

Designed access control and maker-checker rules for corporate banking portals, covering multiple user roles. Made sure duties were properly separated between roles, and the setup was clean enough that the bank's audit team signed off without any issues

KEY SKILLS

Domain Expertise

Banking Digital Transformation · Retail & Corporate Banking · SME & Business Banking · Payments & Transfers · Digital Onboarding · Demat Services · Government Scheme Integration · Core Banking Systems (Finacle)

Consulting & Delivery Current State Assessment · FSD & BRD Authoring · User Story Writing ·

Acceptance Criteria · Backlog Grooming · Sprint Planning · UAT Coordination ·

Product & Design

Customer Journey Design · As-Is / To-Be Process Mapping · Target Operating Model (TOM) Design · UX/UI Collaboration · Greenfield Digital Builds · Feature Prioritisation · KPI Monitoring · Post-Launch Iteration

AI & Analytics

AI-Enabled Process Design · Management Reporting (Qlik/ClickView) ·

Stakeholder Management

Client Engagement · Business & Technical Bridging · Cross-functional Collaboration · Workshop Facilitation · Vendor & Third-Party Coordination

Tools

JIRA · Confluence · MS Visio · Draw.io · Postman · SQL · Figma · Finacle · MS Excel · MS PowerPoint · Agile / Scrum

EDUCATION

Senior Business Analyst with 8 years of experience in digital transformation across banking and financial services, most recently embedded within a large public sector bank's multi-drop digitisation programme at IBM. Brings end-to-end experience across payments, account services, demat, corporate onboarding, and government scheme integrations — from current state assessment and FSD authoring through to SIT coordination. Equally comfortable running client workshops, advising on process redesign, and staying hands-on with development and testing teams to see requirements through to production. Has a good working understanding of core banking systems and integration dependencies, and how these shape the scope and sequencing of digital change. Have also worked with international clients and stakeholders as part of some of these engagements, coordinating across time zones.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Consultant – Digital Banking Transformation | IBM India Pvt Ltd May 2022 – Present Digital Transformation Consultant
Primary BA on a multi-drop digital transformation programme — owned requirements, FSD authoring, and delivery coordination across modules covering dormant account activation, bulk payments, corporate onboarding, demat services, and government insurance schemes (PMSBY & PMJJBY), working directly with the client’s product and IT teams throughout.
Conducted current state assessments of banking processes and IT architecture — identified operational gaps, mapped as-is workflows against the desired end state, and advised on digital interventions to reduce manual touchpoints and improve straight-through processing across key journeys.
Authored FSDs and structured user stories for dormant account activation, bulk payments, corporate onboarding (Branch Portal), demat services, Smart Lock, and PMSBY/PMJJBY enrolment flows — giving development and QA teams a single, unambiguous reference point for each feature from first sprint to production sign-off.
Ran requirement workshops with business, IT, operations, and compliance teams — translated ambiguous business asks into scoped, deliverable requirements backed by clearly defined acceptance criteria, and resolved cross-functional conflicts before they reached development.
During requirement gathering sessions, always made it a point to check if the journey had any regulatory angle — if it did, took time to study the requirement properly and made sure the FSD reflected what was needed before development started
Delivered functional analysis and requirement support for international banking clients, covering both core banking modules and digital journeys
Defined API and integration specifications between Finacle (core banking), UPI switch, digital front- ends, and third-party providers — validated integration behaviour using Postman and SQL, catching critical API edge cases before SIT entry.
Led BA-side review of SIT test case suites — identified 17 missing scenarios in one cycle alone, coordinated resolution with the testing team, and brought test coverage up to standard before UAT entry, materially reducing post-go-live defect risk.
Collaborated with UX/UI designers and product owners to shape customer journeys across web and mobile channels — balancing usability goals against compliance requirements, Finacle constraints, and agreed turnaround time targets.
• Tracked live features post-launch, gathering feedback from business users and product owners,
prioritising backlog items for subsequent drops — keeping the programme roadmap grounded in real usage rather than original assumptions.
Also designed the audit log module for the onboarding journey, capturing every action and change for traceability — this helped the compliance and audit teams review activity
Team Leader – Business Analysis | IDBI Intech Core Banking Enhancements
Jan 2022 – Apr 2022
Led requirement gathering and change impact analysis for lending and account management enhancements on the core banking platform — worked directly with business SMEs to convert policy changes into clear functional specifications and development-ready business rules.
Coordinated SIT and UAT execution — triaged functional defects with the development team and ensured all critical issues were resolved before production sign-off, with no major post-release incidents during tenure.
Facilitated scope alignment workshops between business and IT — reduced ambiguity early in each enhancement cycle and cut the volume of mid-sprint change requests coming from misaligned expectations.
Tracked and escalated delivery risks proactively — maintained delivery transparency across business and vendor stakeholders, ensuring decision-makers had visibility of blockers before they became timeline issues.
Senior System Engineer – Functional Analysis | Infosys Ltd Banking Technology Delivery – Core Banking
Oct 2015 – Jun 2019
Delivered functional analysis and requirement support for banking clients across core banking, account servicing, and trade finance modules on Finacle-based implementations — working across onshore and offshore teams to maintain consistent scope and business rule clarity throughout.
Contributed to change request analysis and impact assessments across multiple enhancement cycles — helped project leads scope work accurately, reduced development rework from scope creep, and shortened overall delivery cycles.
Supported SIT and functional validation cycles on core banking builds — checked system behaviour systematically against business rules, raised defect reports, and worked with development to clear critical issues before UAT entry.
Worked with analytics teams to translate transactional data into management reporting dashboards — gave business stakeholders clear visibility into portfolio performance and processing trends across portfolio and account modules.
Delivered functional analysis and requirement support for international banking clients, covering both core banking modules.
KEY PROJECT HIGHLIGHTS
Dormant Account Activation
Led current state assessment and to-be journey design for dormant account activation across digital and branch channels — reduced manual touchpoints, cut average reactivation time from 5 days to same-day processing for eligible accounts, and authored the FSD covering CBS freeze logic and channel-specific flows. The freeze/unfreeze logic followed RBI's dormancy guidelines, this was a regulatory guideline.
Bulk Payments Platform
Authored FSDs and user stories for bulk payment processing (with and without beneficiary validation), covering STP rules, exception handling, file reconciliation, and reversal logic — greenfield build supporting high-volume corporate payment runs with full audit trail.
CIB Digital Onboarding
Owned FSD authoring for Corporate Internet Banking registration across the Assisted and Admin Portal — enabled self-service onboarding for business customers, eliminated branch dependency for standard corporate journeys, and covered the full lifecycle from registration through access management.
SmartLock – Digital Service Controls
Designed the functional specification for real-time lock/unlock of 5 digital services (Ease App, RIB, UPI, Debit Cards, Credit Cards) — resolved complex UPI switch API behaviour and the RIB self-locking paradox before development started, avoiding costly mid-sprint rework.
Demat Account Services
Authored FSD and defined end-to-end digital flows for demat account services — covering account linking, statement access, and channel integration between the bank’s digital platform and depository systems, with clear business rules for edge cases and error handling. This journey also had to follow SEBI and depository (NSDL/CDSL) guidelines around KYC linkage and account-level checks, so these were factored into the FSD as well
Regulatory & Compliance
Regulatory Requirement Analysis, Access Governance, Maker- Checker Controls, Audit Support, Compliance Coordination
PMSBY & PMJJBY Integration
Defined requirements and digital flows for Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) and Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) enrolment and renewal journeys — covering auto-debit logic, eligibility validation, premium processing, and branch portal integration for bank staff-assisted enrolment.
Access Rights & Entitlements
Designed access control and maker-checker rules for corporate banking portals, covering multiple user roles. Made sure duties were properly separated between roles, and the setup was clean enough that the bank's audit team signed off without any issues
